quests.instruction: Your brother uses your headphones without asking. Which sentence tells him how you feel without attacking him?
quests.correctAnswer: I feel annoyed when you take my things without asking. 🗣️
options: Whatever, keep them, I do not care about my stuff anyway. 🤷
I feel annoyed when you take my things without asking. 🗣️
You are so selfish, you never think about anyone but yourself! 😡
quests.hint: Look for the sentence that starts with your own feeling.
quests.explanation: Starting with 'I feel' shares your experience and invites a response. Name-calling or giving up does not tell him what you actually feel.
quests.funFact: Sentences that start with 'I' are usually easier for people to hear than sentences that start with 'You'.

quests.instruction: Anaya is stuck on a math problem and does not understand the next step. What should she say?
quests.correctAnswer: I am stuck on this step. Can you help me? 🙋
options: I am stuck on this step. Can you help me? 🙋
This stupid question is impossible and nobody can solve it! 😤
I am not asking anyone, I will just give up on it. 🏳️
quests.hint: Which sentence asks for what she needs?
quests.explanation: Saying exactly where she is stuck and asking for help gives the other person something clear to do. Giving up or complaining does not.
quests.funFact: Asking a specific question helps a teacher or friend help you faster.

quests.instruction: A line forms for the swing and you have waited a long time. What can you say to the child using it?
quests.correctAnswer: Please give me a turn when you finish. 🎠
options: Hurry up, you are hogging it! ⏩
Please give me a turn when you finish. 🎠
I will just wait forever and say nothing at all. 🤐
quests.hint: Which sentence is polite and still clear about what you want?
quests.explanation: A polite, clear request tells the other child what you need without insulting them. Saying nothing leaves your need unspoken.
quests.funFact: Using 'please' and saying exactly what you want makes it easier for others to say yes.

quests.instruction: A friend teased your haircut and everyone laughed. Which reply tells your friend the truth about your feelings?
quests.correctAnswer: That hurt my feelings. Please stop. 💔
options: Fine, I will tease you back about yours tomorrow. 😈
It is okay, I was not even listening to you anyway. 🙈
That hurt my feelings. Please stop. 💔
quests.hint: Look for the response that names the effect on you.
quests.explanation: 'That hurt my feelings' names what happened inside you. Teasing back or pretending does not help your friend understand.
quests.funFact: Many people stop teasing when they hear that it hurt, because they did not realize it.

quests.instruction: Before a class presentation, Mateo is nervous. Which sentence tells his friend what he feels and what could help?
quests.correctAnswer: I am nervous about speaking. Can I practice with you? 🎤
options: I am not going and nobody can make me do it. 🚫
It is nothing, so please stop asking me about it. 🤐
I am nervous about speaking. Can I practice with you? 🎤
quests.hint: Which sentence shares the feeling and asks for something useful?
quests.explanation: He names the feeling and asks for a specific kind of support. That makes it easy for his friend to help.
quests.funFact: Practicing with another person is one of the most helpful ways to prepare to speak.

quests.instruction: The teacher notices Jo looks upset after recess and asks what is wrong. Which answer is the most honest and useful?
quests.correctAnswer: I felt left out at recess when the game started without me. 🥀
options: I felt left out at recess when the game started without me. 🥀
Everyone at this school is mean and they all hate me so much. 💢
Nothing at all, I am fine, so please just leave me alone. 🚪
quests.hint: Which sentence describes what happened and how Jo felt?
quests.explanation: Naming the situation and the feeling gives the teacher what she needs to help. Saying 'nothing' or blaming everyone makes helping harder.
quests.funFact: Teachers often can help when they know exactly what happened.

quests.instruction: Mina is studying for a test and the room is noisy. Which sentence best states what she needs?
quests.correctAnswer: I need quiet for ten minutes to finish my homework. 📚
options: I need quiet for ten minutes to finish my homework. 📚
Be quiet right now or I will tell Mom on you! 📣
You never let me do anything in this house. 🏠
quests.hint: Look for a sentence that includes a clear, small request.
quests.explanation: A specific need with a time, like ten minutes, is easy to meet. Threats and 'never' statements make people defensive.
quests.funFact: A clear time limit makes it easier for people to agree to a request.

quests.instruction: Suri's friend thinks she ignored her message, and they are both upset. Which sentence could help?
quests.correctAnswer: I did not see your message. Can we try again? 🔄
options: I am not talking to you anymore, so do not bother. 🚫
I did not see your message. Can we try again? 🔄
You always blame me for everything, every single time. 👉
quests.hint: Which sentence opens the door to talking instead of closing it?
quests.explanation: Sharing what happened and inviting another try repairs the misunderstanding. The other sentences push your friend away or add blame.
quests.funFact: Most misunderstandings can be fixed with a clear explanation and a second try.

quests.instruction: Kian finishes his painting and feels proud. Which sentence shares a good feeling in a friendly way?
quests.correctAnswer: I am proud of finishing my painting. Do you want to see it? 🖼️
options: I am proud of finishing my painting. Do you want to see it? 🖼️
It is no big deal, it is just a painting that anyone could do. 🙄
My painting is way better than everyone else's in the class. 🏆
quests.hint: Which sentence shares pride without putting others down or hiding it?
quests.explanation: Sharing pride and inviting someone to look is friendly. Downplaying it or bragging about being better does not.
quests.funFact: Sharing good news with others can help it feel even better.

quests.instruction: The class trip is canceled because of weather. Which sentence expresses disappointment in a helpful way?
quests.correctAnswer: I am disappointed the trip is canceled. I was looking forward to it. 🌧️
options: I am disappointed the trip is canceled. I was looking forward to it. 🌧️
I do not care about trips anyway, because they are boring and tiring. 🙄
You have ruined everything for all of us, so thanks a lot, everyone. 😒
quests.hint: Which sentence is honest about the feeling and blames nobody?
quests.explanation: It states the feeling and the reason behind it without blaming anyone. Pretending not to care hides the real feeling.
quests.funFact: Saying what you were looking forward to helps others understand why it matters.

quests.instruction: Imani has chores, homework, and a rehearsal all in the same evening and feels overwhelmed. Which sentence invites help?
quests.correctAnswer: I have too much to do. Can we pick the most important one together? 📋
options: I quit, I am not doing any of it tonight at all. 🏳️
I will stay up all night and do it alone, do not talk to me. 🌙
I have too much to do. Can we pick the most important one together? 📋
quests.hint: Which sentence asks someone to work on the problem with her?
quests.explanation: She names the problem and asks for help deciding what comes first. Quitting or going it alone leaves the overwhelm in place.
quests.funFact: Many big loads feel lighter once someone helps you sort them.

quests.instruction: Ayaan is afraid of the dark hallway at night. Which sentence tells his parent what he needs?
quests.correctAnswer: I am scared of the dark hallway. Could you leave the light on? 💡
options: I am scared of the dark hallway. Could you leave the light on? 💡
I will run through it fast and not say anything about it. 🏃
Only little kids are afraid of things like this, so never mind. 🙄
quests.hint: Which sentence says the feeling and asks for a small, clear help?
quests.explanation: Naming being scared and asking for a light is simple, honest, and solvable. Hiding the fear does not solve anything.
quests.funFact: A night-light is a simple tool that helps many children, and many adults, feel safe.

quests.instruction: Your friend has not replied to your messages for days. Which sentence is an 'I feel' statement?
quests.correctAnswer: I feel worried when I do not hear back from you. 📱
options: You never reply, you are a terrible friend to me. 👎
Reply soon, or I am finished being your friend forever. 🔥
I feel worried when I do not hear back from you. 📱
quests.hint: Look for the sentence that talks about how YOU feel.
quests.explanation: 'I feel worried when...' describes your experience. The other sentences blame or threaten.
quests.funFact: An 'I feel' sentence usually has three parts: the feeling, the situation, and sometimes a request.

quests.instruction: Which sentence states a NEED?
quests.correctAnswer: I need help carrying this box. 📦
options: This box is too heavy and nobody ever cares. 📉
I need help carrying this box. 📦
I am so tired of this whole week. 😫
quests.hint: A need says what would help right now.
quests.explanation: 'I need help carrying this box' says what would help. The other sentences describe a feeling or complain.
quests.funFact: Knowing your needs helps you ask for the right kind of help.

quests.instruction: Plans were made without Mia. Which sentence tells how she FEELS, not what she needs or what happened?
quests.correctAnswer: I feel left out when plans are made without me. 🥀
options: The plans were made on Saturday afternoon. 📅
Please include me next time you make plans. 🙋
I feel left out when plans are made without me. 🥀
quests.hint: A feeling sentence uses a word for what you feel inside.
quests.explanation: 'I feel left out' names an emotion. 'Please include me' is a request, and the third sentence is a fact.
quests.funFact: Feelings, needs, and facts are three different kinds of sentences, and each can be helpful.

quests.instruction: Your classmate says, 'It is fine,' but her voice is tight and she looks away. Which reply invites her to be honest?
quests.correctAnswer: You sound upset. Do you want to tell me what happened? 👂
options: Stop sulking, it is not that serious at all. 😒
You sound upset. Do you want to tell me what happened? 👂
If you say it is fine, then I guess it is fine. 👍
quests.hint: Which reply notices the clues and leaves the door open?
quests.explanation: Noticing her tone and offering to listen invites honesty without pressure. Ignoring the clues or telling her to stop sulking shuts the door.
quests.funFact: Tone of voice often says more about a feeling than the words do.

quests.instruction: Someone keeps poking you with a pencil after you asked them to stop. Which response is calm and clear?
quests.correctAnswer: Please stop poking me. I do not like it. ✋
options: Poke me again and see what happens to you. 👊
STOP IT OR I WILL TELL EVERYONE ABOUT YOU! 📢
Please stop poking me. I do not like it. ✋
quests.hint: Which response is firm without threatening?
quests.explanation: A calm, clear request shows firmness without scaring or threatening anyone. If it continues, you can tell a teacher.
quests.funFact: A calm voice can be very powerful. It shows that you mean what you say.

quests.instruction: You interrupted a friend and she stopped talking. Which apology repairs it best?
quests.correctAnswer: I am sorry I interrupted. Can I hear your idea? 🙇
options: I already said sorry. Why are you still mad? 🙄
I am sorry I interrupted. Can I hear your idea? 🙇
Sorry you got upset about it, I guess. 😐
quests.hint: Which apology takes responsibility and fixes the problem?
quests.explanation: A real apology names what you did and offers a way to make it right. Blaming the other person's reaction is not a real apology.
quests.funFact: A good apology often has three parts: what I did, that I am sorry, and what I will do now.

quests.instruction: A bigger student keeps taking your pocket money, and you feel unsafe. What should you say to your teacher?
quests.correctAnswer: A student keeps taking my money and I do not feel safe. Can you help? 🏫
options: I will handle him on my own tomorrow after school without telling anyone. 🥊
It is nothing at all, so please forget that I said anything about it. 🤐
A student keeps taking my money and I do not feel safe. Can you help? 🏫
quests.hint: Which choice brings in a trusted adult for a safety problem?
quests.explanation: When someone is taking things and you feel unsafe, telling a trusted adult is the right step. Handling it alone could put you at risk.
quests.funFact: Telling a trusted adult about a safety problem is a smart and brave choice.

quests.instruction: In a group project, Mei does most of the work. Which sentence could help the group fix it?
quests.correctAnswer: I feel upset because I am doing more of the work. Can we share the jobs? ⚖️
options: I feel upset because I am doing more of the work. Can we share the jobs? ⚖️
I will just stop doing anything at all for this project until someone notices. 🏳️
You are all lazy and you never help with anything in this whole group. 😠
quests.hint: Which sentence names the feeling and offers a way to fix it?
quests.explanation: Naming the feeling and proposing a solution gives the group something to act on. Blaming people leads to arguments.
quests.funFact: Groups often work better when everyone knows who is doing which job.

quests.instruction: Mr. Rao stayed after school to help Nira with her project. Which thank-you tells him how it mattered?
quests.correctAnswer: Thank you for staying. It really made my day easier. 🙏
options: Thank you for staying. It really made my day easier. 🙏
Next time please be quicker about it, though. ⏱️
You did not need to bother with all that for me. 🙄
quests.hint: Which sentence tells him what his action meant to you?
quests.explanation: A thank-you that says what the help changed feels meaningful. The other sentences brush it off or criticize.
quests.funFact: Being specific about why you are thankful makes your thanks mean more.

quests.instruction: Before a vaccination, Tavi's stomach is in knots. Which sentence helps the nurse help him?
quests.correctAnswer: I am nervous about the shot. Can you tell me what will happen first? 💉
options: I am not going in there, and you cannot force me to do this shot today. 🚫
Shots do not bother me at all, so just do it quickly and let me leave. 😎
I am nervous about the shot. Can you tell me what will happen first? 💉
quests.hint: Which sentence tells the truth and asks for something useful?
quests.explanation: Admitting the nerves and asking what will happen makes the nurse's job easier and lets Tavi feel more prepared. Hiding the nerves gives her nothing to help with.
quests.funFact: Knowing what will happen next makes many scary things feel smaller.

quests.instruction: Your friend keeps cutting you off in conversation. Which sentence is a polite and clear way to ask for a turn?
quests.correctAnswer: Can I finish my sentence, please? ✋
options: Never mind, I will stay quiet from now on, then. 🤐
Can I finish my sentence, please? ✋
You always interrupt me, you never listen to anything! 😤
quests.hint: Which sentence is polite and still gets your point across?
quests.explanation: Politely asking to finish is clear and respectful. Blaming 'always' or going silent does not solve it.
quests.funFact: Many people do not realize they interrupt until someone kindly points it out.

quests.instruction: Bina cannot hear her show because her brother's game is loud. Which sentence expresses frustration in a helpful way?
quests.correctAnswer: I am frustrated because I cannot hear my show. Could you lower the volume? 🔉
options: I will just turn my own show up louder than yours, then, so I can hear it. 📢
Turn that down right now, because you are ruining everything in this house! 💥
I am frustrated because I cannot hear my show. Could you lower the volume? 🔉
quests.hint: Which sentence says why and asks for something specific?
quests.explanation: She explains the problem and asks for a small change. Complaining loudly or competing makes the problem bigger.
quests.funFact: A request that says what and why is easier to follow than a command.

quests.instruction: A friend pushes you to try something that feels unsafe. Which sentence says no clearly?
quests.correctAnswer: No thanks, I am not comfortable doing that. 🛑
options: Only silly kids would do something like that. 🙄
Okay, fine, I will do it so you do not leave. 😔
No thanks, I am not comfortable doing that. 🛑
quests.hint: Which sentence stays true to your own feeling?
quests.explanation: A clear 'no' protects you and respects your feeling. Giving in to keep a friend is not a good reason to do something unsafe.
quests.funFact: True friends respect it when you say no.

quests.instruction: A friend says she felt humiliated when her drawing was passed around. Which reply shows good listening?
quests.correctAnswer: It sounds like you felt embarrassed. Is that right? 👂
options: It sounds like you felt embarrassed. Is that right? 👂
That is not a big deal at all, honestly. 🙄
The same thing happened to me, but it was worse. 📖
quests.hint: Which reply reflects her feeling back to her?
quests.explanation: Reflecting what she said and checking that you understood shows you are listening. Dismissing it or making it about yourself does not.
quests.funFact: Checking 'Is that right?' helps people feel understood.

quests.instruction: After losing the game, Aryan says something to his team. Which sentence shows honest mixed feelings in a kind way?
quests.correctAnswer: I am sad we lost, but I am proud of how we played. 🏅
options: I do not care about the game, so it does not matter. 😶
I am sad we lost, but I am proud of how we played. 🏅
We lost because of one person on this team. 👉
quests.hint: Which sentence names two feelings and does not blame anyone?
quests.explanation: He names sadness and pride together and blames no one. That supports the team.
quests.funFact: Mentioning both a hard feeling and a good feeling can help teams recover.

quests.instruction: Sneha wants a turn on the class computer and has waited a long time. Which sentence uses a feeling and a need together?
quests.correctAnswer: I feel left out waiting. Can I have a turn in five minutes? ⏱️
options: You are so unfair, because you always hog the class computer! 😠
I feel left out waiting. Can I have a turn in five minutes? ⏱️
Never mind, computers are boring anyway, so I do not want a turn. 🙄
quests.hint: Look for a sentence that names a feeling and includes a request.
quests.explanation: Combining 'I feel' with a clear request gives the other person information and a way to respond.
quests.funFact: A feeling plus a request is one of the strongest communication tools.

quests.instruction: Ben tells you, 'That hurt my feelings.' Which response helps repair things?
quests.correctAnswer: Thank you for telling me. I am sorry. What can I do? 💛
options: I was only joking, so you should just relax. 😅
Thank you for telling me. I am sorry. What can I do? 💛
You are too sensitive about everything, honestly. 🙄
quests.hint: Which response takes his feelings seriously?
quests.explanation: Thanking him for telling you and offering to make things right shows respect. Dismissing his feelings makes the hurt bigger.
quests.funFact: It takes courage to say 'That hurt my feelings.' A kind reply honors that courage.

quests.instruction: Why does saying 'I feel...' often work better than saying 'You always...'?
quests.correctAnswer: It describes your experience without blaming the other person 🧭
options: It describes your experience without blaming the other person 🧭
It proves to everyone that you are right and that they are wrong ⚖️
It makes the other person agree with you right away, every time ✅
quests.hint: Think about how people react when they feel blamed.
quests.explanation: 'I feel' statements share your experience without an attack, so people are more willing to listen. They do not guarantee agreement, but they open a conversation.
quests.funFact: People are more open to listening when they do not feel blamed.
